summary: CMB.TECH NV filed a routine Form 6-K containing its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The Belgian deep-sea shipping registrant, formerly Euronav NV, disclosed segment, vessel and equity data with no transaction, corporate-action or governance event. XBRL tags reference ordinary balance-sheet, equity-reserve and property-plant-equipment items, plus internal vessel-level member tags. Nothing in the excerpt indicates a special situation; the filing is a standard semi-annual reporting obligation under the 1934 Act. Watch for any later 6-K disclosing a strategic, capital-return or fleet-transaction event.
